output.summary: Agency spend growth is about 77% volume and 23% rate, so H1 fails. Vacancies drive agency use, and agency use loads charge and orientation duty onto permanent RNs. That load raises exhaustion and resignations after about two quarters, which creates more vacancies. The 4 West pilot against matched units supports the load-to-resignation link. St. Brennan's opened too late to start the rise, since resignations climbed from 2024. The 2025 bonus did not hold vacancies down. The CFO plan would suspend the differentials that reward charge and preceptor work, so it is harmful. Extend the 4 West model and renegotiate agency rates as a secondary lever. Falls evidence is confounded by acuity and age. Time-to-hire is unestablished.
